title: Great Migration Annual Cycle
content: The Great Migration involves approximately 1.5 million wildebeest, 500,000 zebra, and 200,000 gazelle moving in a clockwise circuit across the Serengeti-Mara ecosystem. General pattern: December-March: Southern Serengeti and Ndutu for calving. April-May: Central Serengeti, herds moving northwest. June-July: Western Serengeti and Grumeti River crossings. August-October: Northern Serengeti and Masai Mara, Mara River crossings. November: Return south through eastern Serengeti. Timing shifts 2-4 weeks annually based on rainfall patterns. The herds follow the grass, not the calendar.
